description: Blue Team Village at DEF CON 30 focuses on digital forensics, incident response, threat hunting tradecraft, malware reverse engineering, and defensive tooling.

talks.title: YARA Rules to Rule Them All
talks.teaser: Saurabh Chaudhary demonstrates crafting high-performance, modular YARA rules to detect complex malware variants and streamline threat hunting.

talks.title: Threat Hunt Trilogy: A Beast in the Shadow
talks.teaser: Meisam Eslahi presents advanced threat hunting tradecraft to track stealthy adversaries lurking across enterprise infrastructure.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Reverse Engineering Malware - Phishing in the Morning & Abundance of Samples
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian walks through triaging and reverse engineering high volumes of malicious email attachments and phishing lures.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Reverse Engineering Malware - Analyzing Obfuscated PowerShell
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian explores methods for decoding and analyzing heavily obfuscated PowerShell scripts used in initial access payloads.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Mise En Place for Incident Investigations
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian explains forensic preparation and tooling organization to accelerate digital forensics and incident triage workflows.

talks.title: Malware Hunting: Discovering Evasive Techniques in PDF Documents
talks.teaser: Filipi Pires demonstrates techniques for dissecting malicious PDF documents, extracting embedded JavaScript, and uncovering hidden exploit streams.

talks.title: Malicious Memory Techniques on Windows & How to Spot Them
talks.teaser: Connor Morley analyzes Windows in-memory injection techniques—including process hollowing and thread hijacking—and how defenders detect them.

talks.title: Lend Me Your IRs: Effective Incident Response Triage & Telemetry
talks.teaser: Matt Scheurer shares battle-tested incident response methodologies, telemetry sources, and fast containment strategies for enterprise defenders.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Incident Response OODA Loop - An Hour in an Incident Responder's Life
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian breaks down the Observe-Orient-Decide-Act (OODA) loop applied to real-time incident triage and crisis response.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Incident Response - Scoping the Incident from the Ground Up
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian details the critical initial phase of incident response: defining the blast radius, scoping compromised systems, and setting containment boundaries.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Incident Response - Making Final Executive Reporting Exciting
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian shares guidelines for translating complex forensic findings into clear, impactful incident reports for leadership and stakeholders.

talks.title: Securing macOS and Linux Endpoints in Azure Active Directory
talks.teaser: Microsoft Principal Program Manager Mark Morowczynski examines conditional access, identity integration, and posture management for macOS and Linux on Azure AD.

talks.title: Hunting Malicious Office Macros: VBA Deobfuscation & Detection
talks.teaser: Anton Ovrutsky demonstrates behavioral detection patterns, static parsing tools, and deobfuscation methods to hunt malicious Office VBA macros.

talks.title: Horusec: Open-Source Static Application Security Testing for Everyone
talks.teaser: Gilmar Esteves and Filipi Pires present Horusec, an open-source multi-language static analysis (SAST) tool designed to democratize code security scanning.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Using Chainsaw for Rapid Windows Event Log Triage
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian demonstrates using Chainsaw and Sigma rules to rapidly parse gigabytes of Windows event logs and identify malicious artifacts.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: The Importance of Sysmon Telemetry for Investigations
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian details configuring Sysinternals Sysmon to capture critical process creation, network connection, and DLL load events for investigations.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Kill Chain Endpoint Forensics Walkthrough
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian walks through an end-to-end endpoint forensic investigation, reconstructing attacker actions using MFT, Prefetch, and Shimcache artifacts.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Creating Custom Velociraptor Artifact Collectors
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian demonstrates writing custom Velociraptor Query Language (VQL) artifacts to hunt for IOCs and collect forensic evidence across thousands of endpoints.

talks.title: Even My Dad is a Threat Modeler: Demystifying Threat Modeling for Everyone
talks.teaser: Sarthak Taneja presents an accessible, real-world approach to threat modeling, showing how everyday risk intuition translates to software and architecture defense.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Cyber Threat Intelligence - Generating CTI from Live Incidents
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian explains how to extract actionable cyber threat intelligence, TTPs, and indicator clusters from real-time incident investigations.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Cyber Threat Hunting - When the Logs Are Gone
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian shows how threat hunters investigate compromises when adversaries clear event logs, leveraging USN journals, volume shadow copies, and memory artifacts.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Cyber Threat Hunting - Sniffing Out BloodHound in Active Directory
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian demonstrates detecting SharpHound and BloodHound reconnaissance by hunting anomalous LDAP queries and Active Directory enumeration patterns.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Cyber Threat Hunting - Hunting for Adversary Scheduled Tasks & Persistence
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian details hunting for malicious scheduled tasks, cron jobs, and stealthy persistence mechanisms across enterprise endpoints.

talks.title: Project Obsidian: Cyber Threat Hunting - Visualizing Phishing Campaigns & Attack Graphs
talks.teaser: Project Obsidian demonstrates using graph visualization tools to map phishing infrastructure, identify sender anomalies, and correlate multi-stage campaigns.
